WITH als_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (373182, 374631)
  UNION SELECT 373182 UNION SELECT 374631
), als_dx AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS als_dx_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  GROUP BY person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS als_patients, MIN(als_dx_date) AS earliest_dx, MAX(als_dx_date) AS latest_dx
FROM als_dx;

WITH als_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (373182,374631)
  UNION SELECT 373182 UNION SELECT 374631
), als_dx AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS als_dx_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  GROUP BY person_id
), events AS (
  SELECT a.person_id, co.condition_start_date AS event_date, c.concept_name,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dysphag%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dysarth%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%speech%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%swallow%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%aspirat%' THEN 'Bulbar/swallowing'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dyspnea%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%respirat%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hypoventilat%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pneumonia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%atelectasis%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sleep apnea%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cough%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%lung%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pleural%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hypox%' THEN 'Respiratory/pulmonary'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%weakness%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fall%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%gait%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%spasm%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cramp%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%paralysis%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mobility%' THEN 'Motor/mobility'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%malnutrition%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%weight loss%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dehydrat%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cachexia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%feeding%' THEN 'Nutrition/weight'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pneumonia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%infection%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%urinary tract infectious%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sepsis%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fever%' THEN 'Infection'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%anxiety%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%depress%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%insomnia%' THEN 'Neuropsychiatric/sleep'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hypertension%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chest pain%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%tachycardia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%electrocardiogram%' THEN 'Cardiovascular'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%diabetes%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hyperlipidemia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hypothyroidism%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%obesity%' THEN 'Metabolic/endocrine'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%constipation%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%reflux%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%abdominal pain%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%nausea%' THEN 'Gastrointestinal'
      WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%kidney%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%urinary%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%retention%' THEN 'Renal/urinary'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS category
  FROM als_dx a
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=a.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date > a.als_dx_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,a.als_dx_date)
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id NOT IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
), cat_events AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE category IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT category,
       COUNT(*) AS event_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients,
       CAST(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT person_id)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM als_dx) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS pct_of_als_patients,
       MIN(event_date) AS first_event_date,
       MAX(event_date) AS last_event_date
FROM cat_events
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY patients DESC;

), vent_procedure AS (

  WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%home ventilator%'
     OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mechanical ventilator%'
     OR LOWER(c.concept_name) IN ('ventilator','tracheostomy tube')

  GROUP BY a.person_id
)

       MIN(f.first_vent_date) AS earliest_vent,
       MAX(f.first_vent_date) AS latest_vent
FROM als_dx a LEFT JOIN first_vent f ON f.person_id=a.person_id;

  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%weakness%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fall%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%gait%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%spasm%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cramp%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%paralysis%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mobility%' THEN 'Motor/mobility'
  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%malnutrition%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%weight loss%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dehydrat%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cachexia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%feeding%' THEN 'Nutrition/weight'
  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%infection%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%urinary tract infectious%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sepsis%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fever%' THEN 'Infection'
  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%anxiety%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%depress%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%insomnia%' THEN 'Neuropsychiatric/sleep'
  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hypertension%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chest pain%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%tachycardia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%electrocardiogram%' THEN 'Cardiovascular'
  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%diabetes%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hyperlipidemia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hypothyroidism%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%obesity%' THEN 'Metabolic/endocrine'
  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%constipation%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%reflux%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%abdominal pain%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%nausea%' THEN 'Gastrointestinal'
  WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%kidney%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%urinary%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%retention%' THEN 'Renal/urinary'
 END
)
SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS ventilated_patients_with_prior_category,
CAST(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT person_id)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vents) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS pct_of_ventilated,
AVG(DATEDIFF(day, first_event_date, first_vent_date)) AS mean_days_before_vent
FROM vent_events
WHERE category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY ventilated_patients_with_prior_category DESC;

Using OMOP clinical records, I identified 13,595 ALS patients by first ALS/motor-neuron-disease diagnosis and looked for events in the following 365 days. Mechanical ventilation was defined from ventilation/tracheostomy/respirator-dependence condition, procedure, and device concepts.

### Most frequent post-diagnosis event categories

| Category | Patients | % ALS cohort | Event count |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Cardiovascular | 2,885 | 21.2% | 24,451 |

Common individual diagnoses included dysphagia, dyspnea, dysarthria, muscle/facial weakness, constipation/reflux, sleep apnea, pneumonia/atelectasis, UTI, and AKI. “Bell’s palsy/facial palsy” was unusually frequent and may reflect coding noise or facial weakness capture.

### Relationship to mechanical ventilation

Overall, 470 / 13,595 ALS patients (3.46%) had a mechanical-ventilation-related record within 12 months.

Among ventilated patients, prior same-year event categories were:

| Prior event category | Ventilated patients with prior category | % of ventilated | Mean days from event to ventilation |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Respiratory/pulmonary | 367 | 78.1% | 36 days |
| Cardiovascular | 231 | 49.2% | 42 days |
| Metabolic/endocrine | 154 | 32.8% | 60 days |
| Infection | 134 | 28.5% | 34 days |

| Motor/mobility | 106 | 22.6% | 53 days |
| Neuropsychiatric/sleep | 97 | 20.6% | 51 days |
| Nutrition/weight | 87 | 18.5% | 37 days |

Interpretation: respiratory/pulmonary events are the clearest near-term marker for ventilation need: 13.4% of ALS patients with respiratory/pulmonary events were ventilated after the first such event, versus 3.46% overall. Nutrition/weight, infection, renal/urinary, and cardiovascular categories also enriched for subsequent ventilation, but likely reflect severity, frailty, hospitalization, or comorbidity rather than direct causality.

Caveat: this is a heuristic concept-name grouping over EHR codes, not a validated ALS phenotype model; categories overlap, and ventilation coding may miss non-billed home NIV.
